ops.title: P1d resolution: engine lives in internal/proc; fix 3 invariants there + thin root Run wrapper
ops.body:
P1d's build lane correctly checked back on a spec-vs-code contradiction: SPEC-P1d 2.1-2.4 assumed
internal/proc would expose a low-level pipe seam (Spawn + TakeStdin/Stdout/Stderr) over which a root
engine builds collectBounded/deadline/validation. But P1b landed the WHOLE bounded-command engine as
`internal/proc.Store.Run(ctx, Cmd) (Result, error)` -- pipes/collectBounded/deadline all private.
So the root Run can only be a thin wrapper, and the "must-not-regress" invariants live inside
internal/proc.

DECISION (option A, per the user mandate "clean, once, no bandaids"): fix the invariants where the
engine lives, then wrap. The interim root Run uses proc.Cmd/proc.Result DIRECTLY (no conversion
adapter -- BUILD-ORDER forbids it; internal types keep Run externally-uncallable, the point of the
interim shape, unexported at P3), superseding coordination note 0592653's root-native-Cmd sub-ruling.

THREE internal/proc invariant gaps P1d fixes (reproduced by the build lane; the P1b refute+adjudicate
pass MISSED all three -- a review blind spot worth remembering):
- I-1 (REAL BUG): plumb's stdin goroutine swallows its write error --
  `go func(){ _,_ = w.Write(stdin); _ = w.Close() }()` (spawn.go ~:130). A partial/failed stdin
  delivery returns (Result, nil). Reproduced: `sh -c 'exec 0<&-'` + 1 MiB stdin -> err=nil, exit=0.
  Fix: thread the write result out so Store.Run returns the delivery error.
- I-2: output cap discards-past-cap but drains to EOF/deadline instead of terminating the child.
  Reproduced: infinite printer, MaxStdout=4, 4s deadline -> returned ~3.41s (should be prompt).
  Worker's bounded-disposable contract: cap-hit -> terminate child, return promptly, Truncated=true.
- I-10: only empty-Path/NUL rejected; worker required absolute+clean Path and absolute Dir. Add the
  pre-spawn validation (input contract at a public boundary, not a defensive guard).

The deletion/rewire half was unblocked: worker/ has no importer in the compile set (only
wire/daemon/service/runtimeauth, all broken/interim). Corrected P1d workflow re-dispatched
(daemonkit-p1d-v2). Lesson: adversarial review scoped to a prior refuter's findings + "new defects
from the fix" can miss PRE-EXISTING defects outside both -- I-1 predated every P1b finding.
